name: gag-project-monorepo
description: GAG Project - Mind Training Game Platform & MySQL Admin Panel Suite

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "WEB,ADMIN-API,ADMIN-UI" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:admin:api" "npm run dev:admin:ui"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:admin: npm run build --prefix apps/admin/backend && npm run build --prefix apps/admin/frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix apps/web && npm install --prefix apps/admin/backend && npm install --prefix apps/admin/frontend
scripts.db:push:admin: npm run db:generate --prefix apps/admin/backend && npm run db:push --prefix apps/admin/backend
